_comment: The precision proxy per measured model, quoted in reports as a floor on expected false positives (plan §4.1.4). Aggregates only, copied from docs/benchmarking-results.md §1 (category-aware precision proxy). Everything else about a model's benchmark (measured languages, recall, localization) comes from the registry's `benchmark` block in shared/models.json, which guard.test.ts pins to the same ledger; this file carries only what the registry does not. Update it when a row is appended to the ledger.
source: docs/benchmarking-results.md §1, OWASP Juice Shop, category-aware precision proxy
